ns2:course.label: Algebra
ns2:course.description: Rapid review of basic techniques of factoring, rational expressions, equations and inequalities; functions and graphs; exponential and logarithm functions; systems of equations; matrices and determinants; polynomials; and the binomial theorem. Prerequisite: 1.5 units of high school algebra; 1 unit of high school geometry.
ns2:course.courseSectionInformation: Prerequisite: 1.5 units of high school algebra; 1 unit of high school geometry.
ns2:course.classScheduleInformation: Students must register for one Lecture and one Discussion section.
